subject: [PATCH v2 4/6] NFSD: Keep per-export statistics across export cache updates

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where per-export statistics in the NFS server are lost when export cache entries are replaced or removed. To solve this, it introduces a new data structure to store these statistics on a per-net basis, keyed by the export root and client name. This allows statistics to be preserved even after cache updates or restarts. A delayed work item is used to free unused statistics after an hour of inactivity.
